synopsis: After October 7th the world was shocked and sympathetic following the Hamas attacks in Israel. Within a few short months most of this sympathy had gone as the world recoiled in horror at the brutality of the Israeli response to these attacks, while 73% of Israeli Jews expressed support for this response. As a British-American Jew Gillian wanted to know what has happened to make these Jews, a people who have experienced oppression, othering, and genocide, exhibit such moral and humanitarian numbn
tmdb_overview: Why do 73% of Jewish Israelis support the destruction of Gaza?  Directed by BAFTA winning filmmaker Gillian Mosely, 'Planet Israel' answers this question.  Within a few short months after October 7, most of global sympathy towards Israel evaporated as the world recoiled in horror at the brutality of the Israeli response to these attacks, while few Israeli Jews seem to have noticed anything untoward.  As a British/American Jew, Gillian Mosely wanted to know what has happened to make Jews, a people who have experienced oppression, othering, and genocide, exhibit such moral and humanitarian numbness. More widely, how does the moral disengagement that allows atrocities the world over, happen? Gillian thought she was making a film about trauma. But the reality turned out to be so much darker than she’d imagined as the mechanisms behind our disintegrating democracies and international laws are exposed.

The thrilling story of E. Jean Carroll’s life, from her early days as Miss Cheerleader USA to her rise as a trailblazing journalist, author, and beloved advice columnist. Carroll broke barriers as the first female editor at Esquire, Playboy, and Outside, helping to redefine women’s roles in media with her sharp wit and fearless voice. In recent years, she reignited public discourse by standing up to power, becoming the only woman to beat Donald Trump twice in court, and sparking a national conversation about truth, accountability, and resilience. A portrait of an indomitable woman who proved it’s never too late to reclaim your voice, rewrite your story, and change the world.

movie_title: Gaza’s Twins, Come Back to Me
movie_title_en: Gaza’s Twins, Come Back to Me
tmdb_title: Gaza's Twins, Come Back to Me
tmdb_overview: When the Israeli army invades the Gaza Strip in 2023, Rania is eight months pregnant. She gives birth to triplets just as her hometown in northern Gaza is bombed. One girl dies at birth, while the other two babies, Jowan and her brother Hamoud, are so weak that they have to be placed in an incubator. When the hospital is evacuated, the twins are moved to southern Gaza, where Rania’s sister Nisreen takes over their care. A travel ban prevents the babies from returning to their mother.

After a 20-year absence, Noriko returns to Nagasaki to clear out her mother’s home. In doing so, she finds letters that reveal a family secret intertwined with the memory of the peninsular town’s inhabitants. In reconstructing this family story, Okurimono gradually develops into a grace-filled meditation on the passage of time and the legacy we leave behind.

An expansive Russian drama, this film focuses on the life of revered religious icon painter Andrei Rublev. Drifting from place to place in a tumultuous era, the peace-seeking monk eventually gains a reputation for his art. But after Rublev witnesses a brutal battle and unintentionally becomes involved, he takes a vow of silence and spends time away from his work. As he begins to ease his troubled soul, he takes steps towards becoming a painter once again.

Sal is the Italian owner of a pizzeria in Brooklyn. A neighborhood local, Buggin' Out, becomes upset when he sees that the pizzeria's Wall of Fame exhibits only Italian actors. Buggin' Out believes a pizzeria in a black neighborhood should showcase black actors, but Sal disagrees. The wall becomes a symbol of racism and hate to Buggin' Out and to other people in the neighborhood, and tensions rise.

tmdb_overview: Russian poet Andrei Gorchakov journeys through Italy with his interpreter Eugenia to research the life of an 18th-century Russian composer who once lived abroad. Isolated and consumed by an unrelenting longing for his homeland, Andrei becomes drawn to Domenico, a radical mystic obsessed with spiritual redemption. 500 Miles 
Genre(s): DramaUK/Ireland/Cyprus | 2026 | 112 minsDirector: Morgan MatthewsStars: Loré Adewusi, Dexter Sol Ansell, Eoin Duffy, Clare Dunne, Roman Griffin Davis, Deirdre Monaghan, Bill Nighy, David Ryan, Harleen Sahota, Michael Socha.Our 2pm screening includes descriptive subtitles for those with hearing loss and will be followed by a post screening discussion with the Croydon U3A film group. In this emotional and involving drama, Finn and his brother
Charlie run away from their Yorkshire home to escape the turmoil of their

divorcing parents. Carried along by their own quick wits and the kindness of
strangers, they head to the wild west coast of Ireland, the home of their

from a multi generational cast.

synopsis:
A Private Life 
Genre(s): Drama/MysteryFrance | 2026 | 107 mins (French with English Subtitles)Director: Rebecca ZlotowskiCast: Jodie Foster, Daniel Auteuil, Virginie Efira
Foster plays Lilian
Steiner, an American
psychiatrist adrift in Paris —
divorced, estranged from her son, and losing herself in her patients' troubles.
When one of her patients is found dead in an apparent suicide, Steiner can't let it go. Armed with little more
than professional instinct and the reluctant company of her ex-husband played
by Daniel Auteil, she begins to dig. What unfolds is part Hitchcockian thriller
and part wry relationship comedy.
This film contains flashing images which may affect viewers who are susceptible to photosensitive epilepsy
tmdb_overview: The renowned psychiatrist Lilian Steiner mounts a private investigation into the death of one of her patients, whom she is convinced has been murdered.

synopsis:
An American in Paris 
Genre(s): Romance/MusicalUSA | 1951 | 113 minsDirector: Vincente MinnelliStars: Gene Kelly, Leslie Caron, Oscar Levant
Based
on George Gershwin’s tone poem of the same name, which accompanies the ballet
sequence at the film’s climax, as well as songs from the Gershwin catalogue,
this multi-Oscar winning musical stars Kelly as Jerry, a WWII veteran
struggling to succeed as an artist, who falls for Lise (Caron), without
realising she is the girlfriend of his best friend, French singer Henri. Among
other delights in the film is a sequence where Oscar Levant dreams of playing
Gershwin’s Piano Concerto in F – and becomes the conductor, the other musicians
and even a member of the audience!
tmdb_overview: Jerry Mulligan is an exuberant American expatriate in Paris trying to make a reputation as a painter. His friend Adam is a struggling concert pianist who's a long time associate of a famous French singer, Henri Baurel. A lonely society woman, Milo Roberts, takes Jerry under her wing and supports him, but is interested in more than his art.

synopsis:
Birds of War 
Genre(s): DocumentaryUK/Syria/Lebanon | 2026 | 85 mins (Arabic with English Subtitles)Directors: Janay Boulos, Abd Alkader Habak
Birds of War follows
London-based Lebanese journalist Janay Boulos and Syrian activist photographer
Abd Alkader Habak as they piece together their extraordinary long-distance
relationship through 13 years of personal footage, spanning years of
revolutions, war, displacement and exile. From the devastation of Aleppo to a
London newsroom, the film offers an intimate view of life on the frontline and
the emotional turmoil of conflict. Both a powerful documentary and a deeply
personal love story, it asks whether love can survive distance, danger,
profound change and differences. Sundance Film Festival 2026, World Cinema
Documentary Special Jury Award for Journalistic Impact. 
This work contains flashing images which may affect viewers who are susceptible to photosensitive epilepsy.
tmdb_overview: The love story of a London-based Lebanese journalist and a Syrian activist and cameraman as told through 13 years of personal archives across revolutions, war, and exile.

synopsis:
Cactus Pears  +ShortGenre(s): DramaUK/India/Canada | 2025 | 112 mins (Marathi with English Subtitles)Director: Rohan KanawadeStars: Bhushaan Manoj, Suraaj Suman, Jayshri Jagtap, Nitin Bansode, Harish Baraskar, Ram Daund, Vidya Joshi, Hemant Kadam, Rani Kasliwal, Vaishali Kendale
Cactus Pears is a
tender and deeply personal drama set against the striking landscapes of rural
Western India. Following the death of his father, Anand returns from Mumbai to
his ancestral village to observe traditional mourning rituals. Amid mounting
family expectations to marry, he finds an unexpected refuge in Balya, a
childhood friend. As old bonds are rekindled, their connection deepens into
something more. Beautifully shot, Kanawade’s debut is a subtle, moving
exploration of grief, identity and love. Sundance Film Festival 2025 World
Cinema Grand Jury Prize winner. 
Preceded by Two Black Boys in Paradise (9 mins), a
BAFTA-winning animated short.
tmdb_overview: Anand, a 30-something city dweller compelled to spend a 10-day mourning period for his father in the rugged countryside of western India, tenderly bonds with a local farmer who is struggling to stay unmarried. As the mourning ends, forcing his return, Anand must decide the fate of his relationship born under duress.

Hunt for the Wilderpeople 
Genre(s): Comedy/AdventureNZ | 2016 | 101 minsDirector: Taika WaititiStars: Sam Neill, Julian Dennison, Rima Te WiataTaika Waititi's quirky adventure
comedy returns to the DLC to honour the late, great Sam Neill, as well as
marking the film's 10th anniversary. After moving to rural New Zealand, Ricky -
a rebellious eleven-year-old with a passion for hip-hop - is settling into his
new life, being looked after by his loving Aunt Bella, grumpy Uncle Hec and his

threatened, forcing him to go on the run in the bush with his uncle. As
newly-minted outlaws, the pair face a tough choice: go out in a blaze of glory
or overcome their differences and survive as a family.
tmdb_overview: Ricky is a defiant young city kid who finds himself on the run with his cantankerous foster uncle in the wild New Zealand bush. A national manhunt ensues, and the two are forced to put aside their differences and work together to survive.

synopsis:
Ish 
Genre: DramaUK | 2025 | 89 minsDirector: Imran PerrettaStars: Farhan Hasnat, Yahya Kitana, Sudha Bhuchar
Set in Luton, this coming-of-age drama
follows 12-year-old best friends Ish and Maram (non-professional actors Farhan
Hasnat and Yahya Kitana, themselves friends since childhood) as they try to
make the most of their summer. After a traumatic police stop-and-search
incident, cracks begin to appear in their friendship, forcing the boys to
confront the realities of growing up in a world that views them with
suspicion. As their lives gradually
diverge, each must make sense of the men they are becoming and learn that
letting go can be one of the hardest parts of growing up. A contemporary
portrait of British childhood exploring masculinity, friendship and racial
profiling and facial recognition technology with compassion and insight.
This work contains flashing images which may affect viewers who are susceptible to photosensitive epilepsy.

Minions & Monsters 
Genre(s): AnimationUSA/UK | 2026 | 120 minsDirector: Pierre CoffinStars: Zoey Deutch, Allison Janney, Bobby Moynihan, Jesse Eisenberg, Jeff BridgesIn 1920s Hollywood, Minions are enjoying wild success as silent movie stars - until the ‘talkies’ arrive. James and Henry decide to make their own movie and summon fearsome monsters from a mysterious spellbook to play the villains. Lovecraftian creature Goomi leads them on a quest to find the ultimate monster, but when things go haywire, all Minions must band together to save the world. Look out for silent film star cameos and an all-star voice cast in this hugely enjoyable prequel to Minions (2015) and Minions: The Rise of Gru (2022).

synopsis:
NT Live: The Misanthrope 
Genre: PerformanceUK | 2026 | 120 minsDirector: Indhu RubasinghamStars: Sandra Oh, Paul Chahidi, Abigail Cruttenden, Tom Mison, Jemima Rooper
Award-winner Sandra Oh (Killing Eve) plays the title
role in this razor-sharp reimagining of Molière’s classic dark comedy.Telling the truth isn’t always that
simple.Alice, a brilliant novelist,
despises the carefully constructed lies of modern society. But the more she
challenges those around her, the fiercer the backlash becomes.Soon, she must confront the price of speaking
her truth in a world that would rather silence her.

Filmed live on stage at the National Theatre, Indhu
Rubasingham directs Martin Crimp’s (Cyrano de Bergerac) highly
anticipated play.

Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma 
Genre(s): Drama/Horror/Romance/ThrillerUK/USA | 2026 | 112 minsDirector: Jane SchoenbrunStars: Gillian Anderson, Hannah Einbinder, Patrick Fischler, Dylan Baker, Jack HavenOur 7:30pm screening includes descriptive subtitles for those with hearing loss.When up-and-coming director Kris

good and evil.

synopsis:
The Dresser 
Genre(s): DramaUK | 1983 | 118 minsDirector: Peter YatesStars: Albert Finney, Tom Courtenay, Edward Fox, Eileen Atkins, Betty Marsden.
Ronald Harwood adapted his own acclaimed play, which was
based on his own experiences working as a dresser for actor-manager Sir Donald
Wolfit, portrayed as ‘Sir’. Sir is leading a theatre group performing
Shakespeare in the provinces during the war, but his mental capacities are
beginning to fade, and Norman, his dresser, has the task of nursing him into
another performance of King Lear. Courtenay recreates his theatre performance
as the sensitive Norman and Finney delivers a barn-storming Sir.
A 35mm presentation in association with The Cinema Museum.
tmdb_overview: One fateful night in a small English regional theatre during World War II a troupe of touring actors stage a production of Shakespeares King Lear. Bombs are falling, sirens are wailing, the curtain is up in an hour but the actor/manager Sir who is playing Lear is nowhere to be seen. His dresser Norman must scramble to keep the production alive but will Sir turn up in time and if he does will he be able to perform that night? The Dresser is a wickedly funny and deeply moving story of friendship and loyalty as Sir reflects on his lifelong accomplishments and seeks to reconcile his turbulent friendships with those in his employ before the final curtain.

restoration of this well-loved film from 1978. Set in rural Sri Lanka, it tells

and escaping her lowly existence. Both Vasanthi Chathurani, who plays Kusum,
and director Sumitra Peries went on to have distinguished careers in Sri Lankan
cinema.

Tuner 
Genre(s): Crime/Drama/Music/Romance/ThrillerCanada/USA | 2025 | 109 minsDirector: Daniel RoherCast: Leo Woodall, Dustin Hoffman, Havana Rose Liu.
Niki, a young piano tuner and apprentice to octogenarian
Harry, suffers from an extreme auditory sensitivity. This hyperacusis aids his
work but when Harry falls ill, it accidentally presents Niki with a way to pay
mounting medical bills as he cracks safes for Uri and his suspect security
firm. The central relationship between Niki and concert pianist and aspiring
composer Ruthie rings true in its complexity as the tension builds. Stylishly
shot with snappy editing and a cracking score, this debut feature cleverly
combines taut suspense and relationship drama in present day New York.

After years of slapdash sequels and waning fandom, the Camp Miasma slasher franchise is handed over to an enthusiastic young director (Hannah Einbinder, of Hacks fame) for resurrection. But when she visits the original movie’s star (Gillian Anderson), a now-reclusive actress shrouded in mystery, the two women fall into a blood-soaked world of desire, fear, and delirium.

Jane Schoenbrun (I Saw the TV Glow) gives us a playful open-hearted slasher about sex and cinema.

synopsis: Fresh off his Oscar win for Oppenheimer, Christopher Nolan shifts from the atomic to the mythic with an adaptation of history’s most famous ancient text. Homer’s epic details the arduous, danger-filled journey of Odysseus, King of Ithaca, as he travels home from the Trojan War. Awaiting his return is his long-suffering wife, Penelope, who must fend off a horde of conniving suitors, while the king and his dwindling army face the gods’ worst creations and temptations.
tmdb_overview: Odysseus, the legendary King of Ithaca, embarks on a long and perilous journey home following the Trojan War. Throughout his voyage, he is forced to confront the whims of gods, mythological monsters, and trials that stretch both his cunning and his humanity to the breaking point.

movie_title: HUNT FOR THE WILDERPEOPLE (10 Year Anniversary 4K Restoration)
movie_title_en: HUNT FOR THE WILDERPEOPLE (10 Year Anniversary 4K Restoration)
synopsis:
Taika Waititi’s iconic film is back in 4K to celebrate its 10 year anniversary! Ricky (Julian Dennison) is a defiant young city kid who finds himself on the run in the wild New Zealand bush with his cantankerous foster uncle (Sam Neill). A national manhunt ensues, and the two are forced to put aside their differences and work together to survive. 

In memory of the beloved actor Sam Neill (1947-2026)

A world-renowned but reclusive novelist, convinced he is about to die, summons his estranged sons to his home. But instead of seeking forgiveness for their shattered family, he reveals an unbelievable secret that could rewrite their past. 

This star-studded, darkly comedic drama is led by spellbinding performances from Academy Award nominees Bill Nighy and Imelda Staunton, BAFTA nominee George MacKay, BAFTA winner Dominic West, Johnny Flynn, and rising star Noah Jupe.

synopsis:
Ridley Scott’s THE DOG STARS is a riveting, epic thriller set in a world where survival is instinct, but humanity is a choice.

Scott tells the story of Hig, a young pilot who, together with a military survivalist, Bangley, has carved out an efficient but isolated homestead in a brutal post-apocalyptic world until a mysterious radio transmission spurs Hig to venture into the unknown in search of the hope and humanity he still believes exists.
tmdb_overview: After the world's population has been ravaged by a pandemic, a man lives a lonesome existence in a Colorado airplane hangar with his dog and a dour gunman he has befriended. When a mysterious transmission comes through on the radio while he’s flying his old Cessna, it sparks a hunt for the provenance of the sound.

movie_title: A HARD DAY'S NIGHT + LIVE Q&A WITH SAMIRA AHMED
movie_title_en: A HARD DAY'S NIGHT + LIVE Q&A WITH SAMIRA AHMED
synopsis:
Join us for a very special screening of A Hard Day's Night followed by a conversation with Samira Ahmed, author of the new BFI Classics book on "A Hard Day’s Night". Shot in west London, the film follows The Beatles over two days as the band struggles to keep themselves and Paul McCartney's mischievous grandfather in check while preparing for a live TV performance.

The screening is hosted in collaboration with The Chiswick Book Festival.

synopsis:
Ridley Scott’s THE DOG STARS is a riveting, epic thriller set in a world where survival is instinct, but humanity is a choice.

Scott tells the story of Hig, a young pilot who, together with a military survivalist, Bangley, has carved out an efficient but isolated homestead in a brutal post-apocalyptic world until a mysterious radio transmission spurs Hig to venture into the unknown in search of the hope and humanity he still believes exists.

tmdb_title: The Last Guest of the Holloway Motel
tmdb_original_title: The Last Guest of the Holloway Motel
tmdb_overview: In 1970s Britain, Tony Powell was a star defender for Norwich City Football Club — until one day he disappeared from the public eye without a word to family or friends. Decades and seemingly a lifetime later, Tony now quietly resides at the Holloway Motel in the heart of West Hollywood as its manager and sole resident (apart from his dog Samantha). However, after he learns the motel is shuttering and he'll soon be evicted, Tony must finally reconcile his past and present in order to survive and come to terms with the multifaceted relationships of his life: those he's found, lost and abandoned.

tmdb_overview: This feature documentary is a portrait of Peter Watkins, an Oscar®-winning British filmmaker who, for the past 4 decades, has proved that films can be made without compromise. With the proliferation of TV channels, documentaries are enjoying an unprecedented boom fuelled by audiences seeking an alternative to infotainment. But now documentary filmmaking, too, finds itself constrained by the imperatives of television. However, there is a rebel resisting this uniformity of the spirit. Pre-eminent among today's documentary filmmakers concerned about this mind-numbing standardization, Peter Watkins has never strayed from either his principles or the cause.

movie_title_en: Unfaithfully Yours + Live Organ + Richard III - Monday Classic Matinee Double Bill
synopsis:
We are delighted to welcome you back to Regent Street Cinema for a very special Monday Classic Matinee double bill celebrating two remarkable works of classic cinema.

Join us from 1:00pm, where you can enjoy tea and coffee on arrival, followed by a live organ concert and a screening of Unfaithfully Yours (1948), Preston Sturges’ brilliantly witty romantic comedy filled with sharp dialogue, misunderstandings and unforgettable Hollywood charm.

After a short interval, we will continue with Richard III (1955), Laurence Olivier’s acclaimed adaptation of Shakespeare’s iconic tragedy, featuring one of the most memorable performances in British cinema history.

From sophisticated comedy to powerful drama, this special double bill offers a wonderful opportunity to experience two very different sides of classic filmmaking, showcasing the creativity, artistry and enduring brilliance of cinema’s golden age.

tmdb_overview: A year after training young Jackie Chan in the Drunken Fist, Sam the Seed discovers he has a son, Foggy. He tries to train Foggy but to no avail. Foggy is then trained in Drunken Fist from his uncle as he must face his father's rival, Rubber Legs, another Drunken Fist master who combines it with Mantis Fist to create a deadly style.

After the world's population has been ravaged by a pandemic, a man lives a lonesome existence in a Colorado airplane hangar with his dog and a dour gunman he has befriended. When a mysterious transmission comes through on the radio while he’s flying his old Cessna, it sparks a hunt for the provenance of the sound.

movie_title: The Last Guest of the Holloway Motel
movie_title_en: The Last Guest of the Holloway Motel
tmdb_title: The Last Guest of the Holloway Motel
tmdb_original_title: The Last Guest of the Holloway Motel
tmdb_overview: In 1970s Britain, Tony Powell was a star defender for Norwich City Football Club — until one day he disappeared from the public eye without a word to family or friends. Decades and seemingly a lifetime later, Tony now quietly resides at the Holloway Motel in the heart of West Hollywood as its manager and sole resident (apart from his dog Samantha). However, after he learns the motel is shuttering and he'll soon be evicted, Tony must finally reconcile his past and present in order to survive and come to terms with the multifaceted relationships of his life: those he's found, lost and abandoned.

A half hour animated film for all the family based on the much-loved book written by Julia Donaldson and illustrated by Axel Scheffler.  The Snail and the Whale is the much loved classic that shows us a restless young snail who has ambitions to travel the world. The other snails think she should stay put, but she puts out a call for a “Lift wanted around the world”. Eventually her call is answered by a great big grey-blue humpback whale! She sets off with him across the seas. On their journey the snail and the whale discover towering icebergs and far-off lands, fiery mountains and golden sands. The snail is delighted by the wonderful world around her, until she realises how small it makes her feel.

Down-on-his-luck veteran Tsugumo Hanshirō enters the courtyard of the prosperous House of Iyi. Unemployed, and with no family, he hopes to find a place to commit seppuku—and a worthy second to deliver the coup de grâce in his suicide ritual. The senior counselor for the Iyi clan questions the ronin’s resolve and integrity, suspecting Hanshirō of seeking charity rather than an honorable end. What follows is a pair of interlocking stories which lay bare the difference between honor and respect, and promises to examine the legendary foundations of the Samurai code.

tmdb_overview: A full-length ballet created by choreographer Christopher Wheeldon for the Royal Ballet at the Royal Opera House, Covent Garden. The ballet is based on Lewis Carroll's famous story of Alice, an ordinary girl who one summer afternoon falls down a rabbit hole and finds herself on an extraordinary adventure.  The music is by Joby Talbot, with designs by the internationally acclaimed Bob Crowley. Alice is danced by the Royal Ballet's Lauren Cuthbertson, and actor Simon Russell-Beale plays the cameo role of the Duchess.

Marianela Nunez as Odette/Odile and Thiago Soares as Prince Siegfried bring new vitality to a compelling story of tragic romance. Valeriy Ovsyanikov conducts the Orchestra of the Royal Opera House in Tchaikovsky's glorious romantic score.

synopsis:
Hollywood has a monster problem…Follow the Minions in 1920s Hollywood as they aim to make a monster movie of their own and search for frightening creatures to appear in their movie.
But after unleashing monsters upon an unsuspecting world, The Minions must band together to save the day.

Fresh off the worldwide blockbuster success of summer 2024’s funniest comedy, Despicable Me 4, Illumination expands its joyful animated universe with a riotous new chapter, featuring all-new characters, in the biggest global animated franchise in history: Minions & Monsters.

This is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.

The acclaimed voice cast stars Coffin as the Minions, alongside Allison Janney, Christoph Waltz, Jeff Bridges, Jesse Eisenberg, Zoey Deutch, Bobby Moynihan, Phil LaMarr, and Trey Parker.

synopsis:
After their ship gets caught in a mysterious storm, the PAW Patrol pups crash land on an uncharted tropical island filled with dinosaurs. They meet Rex, a pup who has been stranded on the island for years and has become an expert in all things dino-related. 

When the PAW Patrol's archrival, Mayor Humdinger, begins recklessly mining in hopes of exploiting the island for its natural resources, he inadvertently causes a huge, dormant volcano to erupt. The PAW Patrol pups are thrown into a series of high-stakes, dino-sized rescues bigger than anything they've done before, as they must stop Humdinger before everything on the island goes extinct.
tmdb_overview: The Paw Patrol lands on a mysterious dinosaur island after a storm, where they meet Rex, a stranded pup. When Humdinger's reckless mining triggers a volcano, the team faces their biggest rescue mission yet to save the island.

synopsis:
Storks deliver babies... or at least they used to. Now they deliver packages for global internet giant Cornerstore.com.  Junior, the company's top delivery stork, is about to be promoted when he accidentally activates the Baby Making Machine, producing an adorable and wholly unauthorised baby girl.  Desperate to deliver this bundle of trouble before the boss gets wise, Junior and his friend Tulip, the only human on Stork Mountain, race to make their first-ever baby drop - in a wild and revealing journey that could make more than one family whole and restore the storks' true mission in the world.

Join us every Friday or Saturday for toddler-friendly cinema screenings. From ages 1 to 5, share your childhood favourites and the best new family film releases with your pre-schoolers, and we’ll bring you a warm drink and a slice of cake or a small popcorn, all included in the price of your ticket.

Live-action adaptation of the 2016 Disney animated film 'Moana'.

An adventurous teenager sails out on a daring mission to save her people. During her journey, Moana meets the once-mighty demigod Maui, who guides her in her quest to become a master way-finder. Together they sail across the open ocean on an action-packed voyage, encountering enormous monsters and impossible odds. Along the way, Moana fulfills the ancient quest of her ancestors and discovers the one thing she always sought: her own identity.
tmdb_overview: Moana answers the Ocean's call and, for the first time, voyages beyond the reef of her island of Motunui with the infamous demigod Maui on an unforgettable journey to restore prosperity to her people.

synopsis: Spider-Man: Brand New Day marks an entirely new chapter for Peter Parker and Spider-Man. Four years have passed since the events of No Way Home, and Peter is now an adult living entirely alone, having voluntarily erased himself from the lives and memories of those he loves. Crime-fighting in a New York that no longer knows his name, he’s devoted himself entirely to protecting his city — a full-time Spider-Man — but as the demands on him intensify, the pressure sparks a surprising physical evolution that threatens his existence, even as a strange new pattern of crimes gives rise to one of the most powerful threats he has ever faced.
tmdb_overview: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

synopsis:
The toys are back in Disney and Pixar’s “Toy Story 5,” and this time around it’s Toy meets Tech. 

With Woody helping abandoned toys find owners, Jessie is now the leader of Bonnie's room, with Buzz Lightyear as her second-in-command. But the gang’s jobs get exponentially harder when they go head to head with this all-new threat to playtime…a frog-like tablet named Lilypad.
tmdb_overview: When Bonnie receives a Lilypad tablet as a gift and becomes obsessed, Buzz, Woody, Jessie and the rest of the gang's jobs become exponentially harder when they have to go head to head with the all-new threat to playtime.

synopsis:
Disney Princess Season is here! Join us for a week-long celebration of the courage, kindness, and determination that make Disney Princess stories timeless. 

On Thursday, 20 August, hope for a better world with Aladdin. When kind-hearted street thief Aladdin (Mena Massoud) discovers a magic lamp containing a powerful Genie (Will Smith), he is granted the chance to change his life forever. Determined to win the heart of the independent and adventurous Princess Jasmine (Naomi Scott), Aladdin embarks on an unforgettable journey filled with magic, wonder and danger.

As he navigates the bustling streets and grand palaces of Agrabah, Aladdin discovers that true greatness comes not from wishes or wealth, but from believing in yourself and doing what's right. But when the scheming Jafar (Marwan Kenzari) sets out to seize control of the kingdom, Aladdin must find the courage to stay true to who he is and fight for a better world.

synopsis:
Hanging out with mates, partying hard, losing your virginity… That’s how most teenage girls spend their last summer before turning 18.

But not Ivy.

Her lovingly overbearing parents have other plans: four weeks at Children Run Free Camp, a camp for young adults affected by cancer. A quick Google search confirms her fears with a shitty promo trailer - sunsets, crossfades, everything iMovie can vomit up. As if beating cancer wasn’t enough, now she has to go to summer camp.

But ‘Chemo camp’ turns out to be more inspiring than expected. She meets like-minded misfits who just want to ‘fuck shit up’ and live life to the fullest - snorting prescription drugs, downing vodka, skinny dipping... and maybe even falling in love.

Sunny Dancer is a coming-of-age comedy-romance celebrating love, friendship, and challenging adversity: feeling most alive whilst the world has other plans.
tmdb_overview: Ivy is a teenager in remission from cancer, whose mum and dad insist she attend Children Run Free Camp, a summer retreat for young adults affected by cancer. However, as Ivy is reluctantly dragged through camp experience, she discovers new feelings with new friends.

synopsis:
Hollywood has a monster problem…Follow the Minions in 1920s Hollywood as they aim to make a monster movie of their own and search for frightening creatures to appear in their movie.
But after unleashing monsters upon an unsuspecting world, The Minions must band together to save the day.

Fresh off the worldwide blockbuster success of summer 2024’s funniest comedy, Despicable Me 4, Illumination expands its joyful animated universe with a riotous new chapter, featuring all-new characters, in the biggest global animated franchise in history: Minions & Monsters.

This is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.

The acclaimed voice cast stars Coffin as the Minions, alongside Allison Janney, Christoph Waltz, Jeff Bridges, Jesse Eisenberg, Zoey Deutch, Bobby Moynihan, Phil LaMarr, and Trey Parker.

synopsis:
Live-action adaptation of the 2016 Disney animated film 'Moana'.

Together they sail across the open ocean on an action-packed voyage, encountering enormous monsters and impossible odds. Along the way, Moana fulfills the ancient quest of her ancestors and discovers the one thing she always sought: her own identity.
tmdb_overview: Moana answers the Ocean's call and, for the first time, voyages beyond the reef of her island of Motunui with the infamous demigod Maui on an unforgettable journey to restore prosperity to her people.

synopsis:
After their ship gets caught in a mysterious storm, the PAW Patrol pups crash land on an uncharted tropical island filled with dinosaurs. They meet Rex, a pup who has been stranded on the island for years and has become an expert in all things dino-related. 

When the PAW Patrol's archrival, Mayor Humdinger, begins recklessly mining in hopes of exploiting the island for its natural resources, he inadvertently causes a huge, dormant volcano to erupt. The PAW Patrol pups are thrown into a series of high-stakes, dino-sized rescues bigger than anything they've done before, as they must stop Humdinger before everything on the island goes extinct.
tmdb_overview: The Paw Patrol lands on a mysterious dinosaur island after a storm, where they meet Rex, a stranded pup. When Humdinger's reckless mining triggers a volcano, the team faces their biggest rescue mission yet to save the island.

Hanging out with mates, partying hard, losing your virginity… That’s how most teenage girls spend their last summer before turning 18.

But not Ivy.

Her lovingly overbearing parents have other plans: four weeks at Children Run Free Camp, a camp for young adults affected by cancer. A quick Google search confirms her fears with a shitty promo trailer - sunsets, crossfades, everything iMovie can vomit up. As if beating cancer wasn’t enough, now she has to go to summer camp.

But ‘Chemo camp’ turns out to be more inspiring than expected. She meets like-minded misfits who just want to ‘fuck shit up’ and live life to the fullest - snorting prescription drugs, downing vodka, skinny dipping... and maybe even falling in love.

Sunny Dancer is a coming-of-age comedy-romance celebrating love, friendship, and challenging adversity: feeling most alive whilst the world has other plans.

movie_title: Family Film Club: Pirates of the Caribbean: Curse of the Black Pearl
movie_title_en: Family Film Club: Pirates of the Caribbean: Curse of the Black Pearl
synopsis:
Join us at Family Film Club, where we screen much-loved family favourites for ages 5+. Catch a movie off-peak and enjoy half-price kids' tickets. The perfect way to enjoy a cinema outing together as a family.

This week, grab your popcorn and save a sofa for Pirates of the Caribbean: Curse of the Black Pearl - A tale of adventure set during the 17th Century in the Caribbean Sea. For the roguish yet charming Captain Jack Sparrow, the crystalline waters of the Caribbean, like the high seas the world over, present a vast playground where adventure and mystery abound. But Jack's idyllic life capsizes after his nemesis, the wily Captain Barbossa, steals his ship, the Black Pearl, and later attacks the town of Port Royal, kidnapping the Governor's beautiful daughter, Elizabeth Swann. Elizabeth's childhood friend, Will Turner, joins forces with Jack to commandeer the fastest ship in the British fleet, the HMS Interceptor, in a gallant attempt to rescue her and recapture the Black Pearl.

Crime-fighting in a New York that no longer knows his name, he’s devoted himself entirely to protecting his city — a full-time Spider-Man — but as the demands on him intensify, the pressure sparks a surprising physical evolution that threatens his existence, even as a strange new pattern of crimes gives rise to one of the most powerful threats he has ever faced.
tmdb_overview: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

synopsis:
Hanging out with mates, partying hard, losing your virginity… That’s how most teenage girls spend their last summer before turning 18.

But not Ivy.

Her lovingly overbearing parents have other plans: four weeks at Children Run Free Camp, a camp for young adults affected by cancer. A quick Google search confirms her fears with a shitty promo trailer - sunsets, crossfades, everything iMovie can vomit up. As if beating cancer wasn’t enough, now she has to go to summer camp.

But ‘Chemo camp’ turns out to be more inspiring than expected. She meets like-minded misfits who just want to ‘fuck shit up’ and live life to the fullest - snorting prescription drugs, downing vodka, skinny dipping... and maybe even falling in love.

Sunny Dancer is a coming-of-age comedy-romance celebrating love, friendship, and challenging adversity: feeling most alive whilst the world has other plans.
tmdb_overview: Ivy is a teenager in remission from cancer, whose mum and dad insist she attend Children Run Free Camp, a summer retreat for young adults affected by cancer. However, as Ivy is reluctantly dragged through camp experience, she discovers new feelings with new friends.

synopsis: After the Trojan War, Odysseus (Matt Damon) sets out on a perilous journey home to Ithaca. Battling mythical foes including the Cyclops Polyphemus, the Sirens and the enchantress Circe, he must overcome extraordinary trials to return to everything he holds dear: his kingdom, his wife Penelope (Anne Hathaway), and his son Telemachus (Tom Holland).
tmdb_overview: Odysseus, the legendary King of Ithaca, embarks on a long and perilous journey home following the Trojan War. Throughout his voyage, he is forced to confront the whims of gods, mythological monsters, and trials that stretch both his cunning and his humanity to the breaking point.

tmdb_overview: Odysseus, the legendary King of Ithaca, embarks on a long and perilous journey home following the Trojan War. Throughout his voyage, he is forced to confront the whims of gods, mythological monsters, and trials that stretch both his cunning and his humanity to the breaking point.

synopsis: Spider-Man: Brand New Day marks an entirely new chapter for Peter Parker and Spider-Man. Four years have passed since the events of No Way Home, and Peter is now an adult living entirely alone, having voluntarily erased himself from the lives and memories of those he loves. Crime-fighting in a New York that no longer knows his name, he’s devoted himself entirely to protecting his city — a full-time Spider-Man — but as the demands on him intensify, the pressure sparks a surprising physical evolution that threatens his existence, even as a strange new pattern of crimes gives rise to one of the most powerful threats he has ever faced.
tmdb_overview: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

synopsis:
Hanging out with mates, partying hard, losing your virginity… That’s how most teenage girls spend their last summer before turning 18.

But not Ivy.

Her lovingly overbearing parents have other plans: four weeks at Children Run Free Camp, a camp for young adults affected by cancer. A quick Google search confirms her fears with a shitty promo trailer - sunsets, crossfades, everything iMovie can vomit up. As if beating cancer wasn’t enough, now she has to go to summer camp.

But ‘Chemo camp’ turns out to be more inspiring than expected. She meets like-minded misfits who just want to ‘fuck shit up’ and live life to the fullest - snorting prescription drugs, downing vodka, skinny dipping... and maybe even falling in love.

Sunny Dancer is a coming-of-age comedy-romance celebrating love, friendship, and challenging adversity: feeling most alive whilst the world has other plans.
tmdb_overview: Ivy is a teenager in remission from cancer, whose mum and dad insist she attend Children Run Free Camp, a summer retreat for young adults affected by cancer. However, as Ivy is reluctantly dragged through camp experience, she discovers new feelings with new friends.

synopsis:
Hollywood has a monster problem…Follow the Minions in 1920s Hollywood as they aim to make a monster movie of their own and search for frightening creatures to appear in their movie.
But after unleashing monsters upon an unsuspecting world, The Minions must band together to save the day.

Fresh off the worldwide blockbuster success of summer 2024’s funniest comedy, Despicable Me 4, Illumination expands its joyful animated universe with a riotous new chapter, featuring all-new characters, in the biggest global animated franchise in history: Minions & Monsters.

This is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.

The acclaimed voice cast stars Coffin as the Minions, alongside Allison Janney, Christoph Waltz, Jeff Bridges, Jesse Eisenberg, Zoey Deutch, Bobby Moynihan, Phil LaMarr, and Trey Parker.
tmdb_overview: This is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.

synopsis:
After their ship gets caught in a mysterious storm, the PAW Patrol pups crash land on an uncharted tropical island filled with dinosaurs. They meet Rex, a pup who has been stranded on the island for years and has become an expert in all things dino-related. 

When the PAW Patrol's archrival, Mayor Humdinger, begins recklessly mining in hopes of exploiting the island for its natural resources, he inadvertently causes a huge, dormant volcano to erupt. The PAW Patrol pups are thrown into a series of high-stakes, dino-sized rescues bigger than anything they've done before, as they must stop Humdinger before everything on the island goes extinct.
tmdb_overview: The Paw Patrol lands on a mysterious dinosaur island after a storm, where they meet Rex, a stranded pup. When Humdinger's reckless mining triggers a volcano, the team faces their biggest rescue mission yet to save the island.

synopsis:
Marlin, a clown fish, is overly cautious with his son, Nemo, who has a foreshortened fin. When Nemo swims too close to the surface to prove himself, he is caught by a diver and horrified Marlin must set out to find him. A blue reef fish named Dory -- who has a short memory -- joins Marlin and complicates the encounters with sharks, jellyfish, and a host of ocean dangers. Meanwhile, Nemo plots his escape from a dentist's fish tank.

Disney Princess Season is here! Join us for a week-long celebration of the courage, kindness, and determination that make Disney Princess stories timeless. 

On Friday, 21 August, fight for what's right with Beauty and the Beast. Belle (Emma Watson), a bright, beautiful and independent young woman who dreams of a life beyond her village. When her father is taken prisoner in a mysterious castle, Belle bravely offers herself in his place and becomes the captive of a fearsome Beast (Dan Stevens).

Despite her fears, Belle befriends the castle's enchanted staff and gradually learns to look beyond the Beast's frightening exterior. As their unlikely friendship begins to blossom, she discovers the kindness, courage and humanity hidden within. But with the arrogant Gaston (Luke Evans) determined to destroy the Beast, Belle must stand up for what she believes in and fight for what's right.
tmdb_overview: A live-action adaptation of Disney's version of the classic tale of a cursed prince and a beautiful young woman who helps him break the spell.

synopsis:
Disney Princess Season is here! Join us for a week-long celebration of the courage, kindness, and determination that make Disney Princess stories timeless. 

On Friday, 21 August, fight for what's right with Beauty and the Beast. Belle (Emma Watson), a bright, beautiful and independent young woman who dreams of a life beyond her village. When her father is taken prisoner in a mysterious castle, Belle bravely offers herself in his place and becomes the captive of a fearsome Beast (Dan Stevens).

Despite her fears, Belle befriends the castle's enchanted staff and gradually learns to look beyond the Beast's frightening exterior. As their unlikely friendship begins to blossom, she discovers the kindness, courage and humanity hidden within. But with the arrogant Gaston (Luke Evans) determined to destroy the Beast, Belle must stand up for what she believes in and fight for what's right.

synopsis:
Hanging out with mates, partying hard, losing your virginity… That’s how most teenage girls spend their last summer before turning 18.

But not Ivy.

Her lovingly overbearing parents have other plans: four weeks at Children Run Free Camp, a camp for young adults affected by cancer. A quick Google search confirms her fears with a shitty promo trailer - sunsets, crossfades, everything iMovie can vomit up. As if beating cancer wasn’t enough, now she has to go to summer camp.

But ‘Chemo camp’ turns out to be more inspiring than expected. She meets like-minded misfits who just want to ‘fuck shit up’ and live life to the fullest - snorting prescription drugs, downing vodka, skinny dipping... and maybe even falling in love.

Sunny Dancer is a coming-of-age comedy-romance celebrating love, friendship, and challenging adversity: feeling most alive whilst the world has other plans.

synopsis: In Insidious: Out of the Further, Amelia Eve stars as Gemma, a young mother raising her daughter in the house she grew up in who discovers she can travel into The Further, the purgatorial realm of lost souls at the heart of the Insidious universe. When something evil comes after her, Gemma discovers an ability that changes everything: she doesn’t just enter The Further, she can bring what lives there back to the real world. Once the demons realise her power, our world becomes their playground.
tmdb_overview: Gemma, a young mother raising her daughter in the house she grew up in, discovers she can travel into The Further, where she possesses an ability to bring what lives there back to the real world.

synopsis: Spider-Man: Brand New Day marks an entirely new chapter for Peter Parker and Spider-Man. Four years have passed since the events of No Way Home, and Peter is now an adult living entirely alone, having voluntarily erased himself from the lives and memories of those he loves. Crime-fighting in a New York that no longer knows his name, he’s devoted himself entirely to protecting his city — a full-time Spider-Man — but as the demands on him intensify, the pressure sparks a surprising physical evolution that threatens his existence, even as a strange new pattern of crimes gives rise to one of the most powerful threats he has ever faced.
tmdb_overview: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

synopsis:
Hanging out with mates, partying hard, losing your virginity… That’s how most teenage girls spend their last summer before turning 18.

But not Ivy.

Her lovingly overbearing parents have other plans: four weeks at Children Run Free Camp, a camp for young adults affected by cancer. A quick Google search confirms her fears with a shitty promo trailer - sunsets, crossfades, everything iMovie can vomit up. As if beating cancer wasn’t enough, now she has to go to summer camp.

But ‘Chemo camp’ turns out to be more inspiring than expected. She meets like-minded misfits who just want to ‘fuck shit up’ and live life to the fullest - snorting prescription drugs, downing vodka, skinny dipping... and maybe even falling in love.

Sunny Dancer is a coming-of-age comedy-romance celebrating love, friendship, and challenging adversity: feeling most alive whilst the world has other plans.
tmdb_overview: Ivy is a teenager in remission from cancer, whose mum and dad insist she attend Children Run Free Camp, a summer retreat for young adults affected by cancer. However, as Ivy is reluctantly dragged through camp experience, she discovers new feelings with new friends.

synopsis:
Doesn't it make you proud to be Scottish?

Choose a classic and satisfy your lust for life as Renton, Spud, Sick Boy, and Begbie return to the big screen. Among the most popular, ground-breaking, and influential films of the ‘90s, Trainspotting is back on the big screen from 21st August in brand new 4K restoration – supervised by director Danny Boyle and supported by new marketing materials.
tmdb_overview: Heroin addict Mark Renton stumbles through bad ideas and sobriety attempts with his unreliable friends --Sick Boy, Begbie, Spud and Tommy. He also has an underage girlfriend, Diane, along for the ride. After cleaning up and moving from Edinburgh to London, Mark finds he can't escape the life he left behind as Begbie and Sick Boy come knocking.

synopsis: After the Trojan War, Odysseus (Matt Damon) sets out on a perilous journey home to Ithaca. Battling mythical foes including the Cyclops Polyphemus, the Sirens and the enchantress Circe, he must overcome extraordinary trials to return to everything he holds dear: his kingdom, his wife Penelope (Anne Hathaway), and his son Telemachus (Tom Holland).
tmdb_overview: Odysseus, the legendary King of Ithaca, embarks on a long and perilous journey home following the Trojan War. Throughout his voyage, he is forced to confront the whims of gods, mythological monsters, and trials that stretch both his cunning and his humanity to the breaking point.

Tired from decades of being blown up by explosive ACME products whilst in pursuit of the uncatchable Road Runner, Wile E. synopsis: Spider-Man: Brand New Day marks an entirely new chapter for Peter Parker and Spider-Man. Four years have passed since the events of No Way Home, and Peter is now an adult living entirely alone, having voluntarily erased himself from the lives and memories of those he loves. Crime-fighting in a New York that no longer knows his name, he’s devoted himself entirely to protecting his city — a full-time Spider-Man — but as the demands on him intensify, the pressure sparks a surprising physical evolution that threatens his existence, even as a strange new pattern of crimes gives rise to one of the most powerful threats he has ever faced.
tmdb_overview: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

synopsis: In Insidious: Out of the Further, Amelia Eve stars as Gemma, a young mother raising her daughter in the house she grew up in who discovers she can travel into The Further, the purgatorial realm of lost souls at the heart of the Insidious universe. synopsis: Spider-Man: Brand New Day marks an entirely new chapter for Peter Parker and Spider-Man. Four years have passed since the events of No Way Home, and Peter is now an adult living entirely alone, having voluntarily erased himself from the lives and memories of those he loves. Crime-fighting in a New York that no longer knows his name, he’s devoted himself entirely to protecting his city — a full-time Spider-Man — but as the demands on him intensify, the pressure sparks a surprising physical evolution that threatens his existence, even as a strange new pattern of crimes gives rise to one of the most powerful threats he has ever faced.

synopsis:
After their ship gets caught in a mysterious storm, the PAW Patrol pups crash land on an uncharted tropical island filled with dinosaurs. They meet Rex, a pup who has been stranded on the island for years and has become an expert in all things dino-related. 

When the PAW Patrol's archrival, Mayor Humdinger, begins recklessly mining in hopes of exploiting the island for its natural resources, he inadvertently causes a huge, dormant volcano to erupt. The PAW Patrol pups are thrown into a series of high-stakes, dino-sized rescues bigger than anything they've done before, as they must stop Humdinger before everything on the island goes extinct.

synopsis:
Welcome to Relaxed Screenings - a comfortable and inclusive way to enjoy the magic of the movies in a sensory and autism-friendly environment. Every month, we host a special screening with reduced volume, dimmed lighting, and no ads or trailers, creating a calm and stress-free setting for neurodiverse guests, including those with autism and sensory sensitivities, and their friends, family, and carers.

Join us Sunday, 23 August, for a relaxed screening of Spider-Man: Brand New Day - Four years have passed since the events of No Way Home, and Peter is now an adult living entirely alone, having voluntarily erased himself from the lives and memories of those he loves. 

Crime-fighting in a New York that no longer knows his name, he’s devoted himself entirely to protecting his city — a full-time Spider-Man — but as the demands on him intensify, the pressure sparks a surprising physical evolution that threatens his existence, even as a strange new pattern of crimes gives rise to one of the most powerful threats he has ever faced.

BBFC Content Warning - Spider-Man: Brand New Day is rated 12A with moderate violence, threat, injury detail, and implied strong language. Check the BBFC website for further information: https://www.bbfc.co.uk/release/spider-man-brand-new-day-q29sbgvjdglvbjpwwc0xmtezmty0

synopsis:
Marlin, a clown fish, is overly cautious with his son, Nemo, who has a foreshortened fin. When Nemo swims too close to the surface to prove himself, he is caught by a diver and horrified Marlin must set out to find him. A blue reef fish named Dory -- who has a short memory -- joins Marlin and complicates the encounters with sharks, jellyfish, and a host of ocean dangers. Meanwhile, Nemo plots his escape from a dentist's fish tank.

Disney Princess Season is here! Join us for a week-long celebration of the courage, kindness, and determination that make Disney Princess stories timeless. 

On Saturday, 22 August, nothing is impossible with Cinderella. The timeless tale follows Ella (Lily James), a kind-hearted young woman whose life is turned upside down after the loss of her beloved father. Forced to live under the rule of her cruel stepmother, Lady Tremaine (Cate Blanchett), and her jealous stepsisters, Ella refuses to let hardship change her gentle spirit.

When a chance encounter in the woods introduces her to a charming stranger who is secretly the Prince (Richard Madden), Ella discovers that her destiny may be greater than she ever imagined. With a little help from her Fairy Godmother (Helena Bonham Carter), she finds the courage to believe in herself and show that nothing is impossible.

Hollywood has a monster problem…Follow the Minions in 1920s Hollywood as they aim to make a monster movie of their own and search for frightening creatures to appear in their movie.
But after unleashing monsters upon an unsuspecting world, The Minions must band together to save the day.

Fresh off the worldwide blockbuster success of summer 2024’s funniest comedy, Despicable Me 4, Illumination expands its joyful animated universe with a riotous new chapter, featuring all-new characters, in the biggest global animated franchise in history: Minions & Monsters.

This is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.

The acclaimed voice cast stars Coffin as the Minions, alongside Allison Janney, Christoph Waltz, Jeff Bridges, Jesse Eisenberg, Zoey Deutch, Bobby Moynihan, Phil LaMarr, and Trey Parker.

Battling mythical foes including the Cyclops Polyphemus, the Sirens and the enchantress Circe, he must overcome extraordinary trials to return to everything he holds dear: his kingdom, his wife Penelope (Anne Hathaway), and his son Telemachus (Tom Holland).

synopsis:
Hanging out with mates, partying hard, losing your virginity… That’s how most teenage girls spend their last summer before turning 18.

But not Ivy.

Her lovingly overbearing parents have other plans: four weeks at Children Run Free Camp, a camp for young adults affected by cancer. A quick Google search confirms her fears with a shitty promo trailer - sunsets, crossfades, everything iMovie can vomit up. As if beating cancer wasn’t enough, now she has to go to summer camp.

But ‘Chemo camp’ turns out to be more inspiring than expected. She meets like-minded misfits who just want to ‘fuck shit up’ and live life to the fullest - snorting prescription drugs, downing vodka, skinny dipping... and maybe even falling in love.

Sunny Dancer is a coming-of-age comedy-romance celebrating love, friendship, and challenging adversity: feeling most alive whilst the world has other plans.

synopsis:
Hanging out with mates, partying hard, losing your virginity… That’s how most teenage girls spend their last summer before turning 18.

But not Ivy.

Her lovingly overbearing parents have other plans: four weeks at Children Run Free Camp, a camp for young adults affected by cancer. A quick Google search confirms her fears with a shitty promo trailer - sunsets, crossfades, everything iMovie can vomit up. As if beating cancer wasn’t enough, now she has to go to summer camp.

But ‘Chemo camp’ turns out to be more inspiring than expected. She meets like-minded misfits who just want to ‘fuck shit up’ and live life to the fullest - snorting prescription drugs, downing vodka, skinny dipping... and maybe even falling in love.

Sunny Dancer is a coming-of-age comedy-romance celebrating love, friendship, and challenging adversity: feeling most alive whilst the world has other plans.
tmdb_overview: Ivy is a teenager in remission from cancer, whose mum and dad insist she attend Children Run Free Camp, a summer retreat for young adults affected by cancer. However, as Ivy is reluctantly dragged through camp experience, she discovers new feelings with new friends.

Crime-fighting in a New York that no longer knows his name, he’s devoted himself entirely to protecting his city — a full-time Spider-Man — but as the demands on him intensify, the pressure sparks a surprising physical evolution that threatens his existence, even as a strange new pattern of crimes gives rise to one of the most powerful threats he has ever faced.
tmdb_overview: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

synopsis: Stop! That! Train! follows best friends Tess (Ginger Minj) and DeeDee (Jujubee), train stewardesses who trade their dreary shifts on the Stank Rail for the glitzy Glamazonian Express. When a catastrophic “Stormaganza” threatens to derail the high-speed train and crash it into Florida, the duo in coach must join forces with the snobby first class attendants (Symone, Brooke Lynn Hytes, Marcia Marcia Marcia) and President Gagwell (RuPaul) to save the day in this wild ride of camp and comedy.
tmdb_overview: Best friends and train stewardesses Tess and DeeDee trade their dreary shifts on the Stank Rail for the glitzy Glamazonian Express. However, when a catastrophic Stormaganza threatens to crash the high-speed train into Celebration, Florida, the duo in coach must join forces with the snobby first-class attendants, a hot but dimwitted co-conductor, and fabulous US President Judy Gagwell to save the day.

synopsis:
Hollywood has a monster problem…Follow the Minions in 1920s Hollywood as they aim to make a monster movie of their own and search for frightening creatures to appear in their movie.
But after unleashing monsters upon an unsuspecting world, The Minions must band together to save the day.

Fresh off the worldwide blockbuster success of summer 2024’s funniest comedy, Despicable Me 4, Illumination expands its joyful animated universe with a riotous new chapter, featuring all-new characters, in the biggest global animated franchise in history: Minions & Monsters.

This is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.

The acclaimed voice cast stars Coffin as the Minions, alongside Allison Janney, Christoph Waltz, Jeff Bridges, Jesse Eisenberg, Zoey Deutch, Bobby Moynihan, Phil LaMarr, and Trey Parker.
tmdb_overview: This is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.

synopsis:
Welcome to Relaxed Screenings - a comfortable and inclusive way to enjoy the magic of the movies in a sensory and autism-friendly environment. Every month, we host a special screening with reduced volume, dimmed lighting, and no ads or trailers, creating a calm and stress-free setting for neurodiverse guests, including those with autism and sensory sensitivities, and their friends, family, and carers.

Join us Sunday, 23 August, for a relaxed screening of Spider-Man: Brand New Day - Four years have passed since the events of No Way Home, and Peter is now an adult living entirely alone, having voluntarily erased himself from the lives and memories of those he loves. 

Crime-fighting in a New York that no longer knows his name, he’s devoted himself entirely to protecting his city — a full-time Spider-Man — but as the demands on him intensify, the pressure sparks a surprising physical evolution that threatens his existence, even as a strange new pattern of crimes gives rise to one of the most powerful threats he has ever faced.

synopsis:
Marlin, a clown fish, is overly cautious with his son, Nemo, who has a foreshortened fin. When Nemo swims too close to the surface to prove himself, he is caught by a diver and horrified Marlin must set out to find him. A blue reef fish named Dory -- who has a short memory -- joins Marlin and complicates the encounters with sharks, jellyfish, and a host of ocean dangers. Meanwhile, Nemo plots his escape from a dentist's fish tank.

Join us every Friday or Saturday for toddler-friendly cinema screenings. From ages 1 to 5, share your childhood favourites and the best new family film releases with your pre-schoolers, and we’ll bring you a warm drink and a slice of cake or a small popcorn, all included in the price of your ticket.

After their ship gets caught in a mysterious storm, the PAW Patrol pups crash land on an uncharted tropical island filled with dinosaurs. They meet Rex, a pup who has been stranded on the island for years and has become an expert in all things dino-related. 

When the PAW Patrol's archrival, Mayor Humdinger, begins recklessly mining in hopes of exploiting the island for its natural resources, he inadvertently causes a huge, dormant volcano to erupt. The PAW Patrol pups are thrown into a series of high-stakes, dino-sized rescues bigger than anything they've done before, as they must stop Humdinger before everything on the island goes extinct.
tmdb_overview: The Paw Patrol lands on a mysterious dinosaur island after a storm, where they meet Rex, a stranded pup. When Humdinger's reckless mining triggers a volcano, the team faces their biggest rescue mission yet to save the island.

synopsis:
Live-action adaptation of the 2016 Disney animated film 'Moana'.

An adventurous teenager sails out on a daring mission to save her people. During her journey, Moana meets the once-mighty demigod Maui, who guides her in her quest to become a master way-finder. Together they sail across the open ocean on an action-packed voyage, encountering enormous monsters and impossible odds. Along the way, Moana fulfills the ancient quest of her ancestors and discovers the one thing she always sought: her own identity.
tmdb_overview: Moana answers the Ocean's call and, for the first time, voyages beyond the reef of her island of Motunui with the infamous demigod Maui on an unforgettable journey to restore prosperity to her people.

Crime-fighting in a New York that no longer knows his name, he’s devoted himself entirely to protecting his city — a full-time Spider-Man — but as the demands on him intensify, the pressure sparks a surprising physical evolution that threatens his existence, even as a strange new pattern of crimes gives rise to one of the most powerful threats he has ever faced.
tmdb_overview: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

synopsis:
After their ship gets caught in a mysterious storm, the PAW Patrol pups crash land on an uncharted tropical island filled with dinosaurs. They meet Rex, a pup who has been stranded on the island for years and has become an expert in all things dino-related. 

When the PAW Patrol's archrival, Mayor Humdinger, begins recklessly mining in hopes of exploiting the island for its natural resources, he inadvertently causes a huge, dormant volcano to erupt. The PAW Patrol pups are thrown into a series of high-stakes, dino-sized rescues bigger than anything they've done before, as they must stop Humdinger before everything on the island goes extinct.
tmdb_overview: The Paw Patrol lands on a mysterious dinosaur island after a storm, where they meet Rex, a stranded pup. When Humdinger's reckless mining triggers a volcano, the team faces their biggest rescue mission yet to save the island.

synopsis:
Hanging out with mates, partying hard, losing your virginity… That’s how most teenage girls spend their last summer before turning 18.

But not Ivy.

Her lovingly overbearing parents have other plans: four weeks at Children Run Free Camp, a camp for young adults affected by cancer. A quick Google search confirms her fears with a shitty promo trailer - sunsets, crossfades, everything iMovie can vomit up. As if beating cancer wasn’t enough, now she has to go to summer camp.

But ‘Chemo camp’ turns out to be more inspiring than expected. She meets like-minded misfits who just want to ‘fuck shit up’ and live life to the fullest - snorting prescription drugs, downing vodka, skinny dipping... and maybe even falling in love.

Sunny Dancer is a coming-of-age comedy-romance celebrating love, friendship, and challenging adversity: feeling most alive whilst the world has other plans.
tmdb_overview: Ivy is a teenager in remission from cancer, whose mum and dad insist she attend Children Run Free Camp, a summer retreat for young adults affected by cancer. However, as Ivy is reluctantly dragged through camp experience, she discovers new feelings with new friends.

synopsis:
In the part second of the Tolkien trilogy, Frodo Baggins and the other members of the Fellowship continue on their sacred quest to destroy the One Ring--but on separate paths. Their destinies lie at two towers--Orthanc Tower in Isengard, where the corrupt wizard Saruman awaits, and Sauron's fortress at Barad-dur, deep within the dark lands of Mordor.

Screening on Sundays and Tuesdays as part of our Throwback Season where we revisit classics. Each ticket to these showtimes includes complimentary popcorn and a drink.

movie_title_en: Throwback: The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers (Extended Edition)
synopsis:
In the part second of the Tolkien trilogy, Frodo Baggins and the other members of the Fellowship continue on their sacred quest to destroy the One Ring--but on separate paths. Their destinies lie at two towers--Orthanc Tower in Isengard, where the corrupt wizard Saruman awaits, and Sauron's fortress at Barad-dur, deep within the dark lands of Mordor.

Screening on Sundays and Tuesdays as part of our Throwback Season where we revisit classics. Each ticket to these showtimes includes complimentary popcorn and a drink.

tmdb_overview: Three friends go on a spa weekend that descends into chaos when their trainwreck friend joins, leading to hilarious consequences.

synopsis: Spider-Man: Brand New Day marks an entirely new chapter for Peter Parker and Spider-Man. Four years have passed since the events of No Way Home, and Peter is now an adult living entirely alone, having voluntarily erased himself from the lives and memories of those he loves. Crime-fighting in a New York that no longer knows his name, he’s devoted himself entirely to protecting his city — a full-time Spider-Man — but as the demands on him intensify, the pressure sparks a surprising physical evolution that threatens his existence, even as a strange new pattern of crimes gives rise to one of the most powerful threats he has ever faced.
tmdb_overview: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

synopsis:
After their ship gets caught in a mysterious storm, the PAW Patrol pups crash land on an uncharted tropical island filled with dinosaurs. They meet Rex, a pup who has been stranded on the island for years and has become an expert in all things dino-related. 

When the PAW Patrol's archrival, Mayor Humdinger, begins recklessly mining in hopes of exploiting the island for its natural resources, he inadvertently causes a huge, dormant volcano to erupt. The PAW Patrol pups are thrown into a series of high-stakes, dino-sized rescues bigger than anything they've done before, as they must stop Humdinger before everything on the island goes extinct.
tmdb_overview: The Paw Patrol lands on a mysterious dinosaur island after a storm, where they meet Rex, a stranded pup. When Humdinger's reckless mining triggers a volcano, the team faces their biggest rescue mission yet to save the island.

synopsis:
Join us for a Toddler Club double-bill, featuring Julia Donaldson's famous children's tales on the big screen!

THE HIGHWAY RAT
The Highway Rat is a short animation based on a popular children’s story by Julia Donaldson and illustrated by Axel Scheffler in which a ravenous rat searches for sugary treats to steal.

ZOG AND THE FLYING DOCTORS
Zog and the Flying Doctors is a family animation in which a princess dreams of becoming a doctor.

Join us every Friday or Saturday for toddler-friendly cinema screenings. From ages 1 to 5, share your childhood favourites and the best new family film releases with your pre-schoolers, and we’ll bring you a warm drink and a slice of cake or a small popcorn, all included in the price of your ticket.

Coyote teams up with lawyer Kevin Avery (Will Forte) to fight back in COYOTE vs. ACME. But ACME has its own powerhouse defence attorney in Kevin’s slick nemesis Buddy Crane (John Cena), who is determined to silence Wile E. and Kevin.

Wile E. and Kevin embark on a wild quest for justice that’s as thrilling and physics-defying as Wile E.’s lifelong chase for the ever-speedy Road Runner.

synopsis:
Disney Princess Season is here! Join us for a week-long celebration of the courage, kindness, and determination that make Disney Princess stories timeless. 

On Monday, 24 August, trust in yourself with The Princess and the Frog. Tiana (Anika Noni Rose) is a hardworking and ambitious young woman in 1920s New Orleans who dreams of opening her own restaurant. When she meets the charming Prince Naveen (Bruno Campos), who has been transformed into a frog by the sinister Dr Facilier (Keith David), an unexpected kiss leaves Tiana facing the same fate.

Together, Tiana and Naveen embark on a magical adventure through the Louisiana bayou in search of a way to break the spell. Along the way, they encounter colourful new friends, unexpected dangers and life-changing lessons about love, friendship and what truly matters. 

As Tiana works towards the future she has always dreamed of, she'll discover that success doesn't come from wishing upon a star alone. It comes from determination, believing in your own abilities and having the courage to trust in yourself.
tmdb_overview: A waitress, desperate to fulfill her dreams as a restaurant owner, is set on a journey to turn a frog prince back into a human being, but she has to face the same problem after she kisses him.

Hollywood has a monster problem…Follow the Minions in 1920s Hollywood as they aim to make a monster movie of their own and search for frightening creatures to appear in their movie.
But after unleashing monsters upon an unsuspecting world, The Minions must band together to save the day.

Fresh off the worldwide blockbuster success of summer 2024’s funniest comedy, Despicable Me 4, Illumination expands its joyful animated universe with a riotous new chapter, featuring all-new characters, in the biggest global animated franchise in history: Minions & Monsters.

This is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.

The acclaimed voice cast stars Coffin as the Minions, alongside Allison Janney, Christoph Waltz, Jeff Bridges, Jesse Eisenberg, Zoey Deutch, Bobby Moynihan, Phil LaMarr, and Trey Parker.

synopsis:
Join us for a Toddler Club double-bill, featuring Julia Donaldson's famous children's tales on the big screen!

THE HIGHWAY RAT
The Highway Rat is a short animation based on a popular children’s story by Julia Donaldson and illustrated by Axel Scheffler in which a ravenous rat searches for sugary treats to steal.

ZOG AND THE FLYING DOCTORS
Zog and the Flying Doctors is a family animation in which a princess dreams of becoming a doctor.

Join us every Friday or Saturday for toddler-friendly cinema screenings. synopsis:
Hanging out with mates, partying hard, losing your virginity… That’s how most teenage girls spend their last summer before turning 18.

But not Ivy.

Her lovingly overbearing parents have other plans: four weeks at Children Run Free Camp, a camp for young adults affected by cancer. A quick Google search confirms her fears with a shitty promo trailer - sunsets, crossfades, everything iMovie can vomit up. As if beating cancer wasn’t enough, now she has to go to summer camp.

But ‘Chemo camp’ turns out to be more inspiring than expected. She meets like-minded misfits who just want to ‘fuck shit up’ and live life to the fullest - snorting prescription drugs, downing vodka, skinny dipping... and maybe even falling in love.

Sunny Dancer is a coming-of-age comedy-romance celebrating love, friendship, and challenging adversity: feeling most alive whilst the world has other plans.
tmdb_overview: Ivy is a teenager in remission from cancer, whose mum and dad insist she attend Children Run Free Camp, a summer retreat for young adults affected by cancer. However, as Ivy is reluctantly dragged through camp experience, she discovers new feelings with new friends.

synopsis:
Hanging out with mates, partying hard, losing your virginity… That’s how most teenage girls spend their last summer before turning 18.

But not Ivy.

Her lovingly overbearing parents have other plans: four weeks at Children Run Free Camp, a camp for young adults affected by cancer. A quick Google search confirms her fears with a shitty promo trailer - sunsets, crossfades, everything iMovie can vomit up. As if beating cancer wasn’t enough, now she has to go to summer camp.

But ‘Chemo camp’ turns out to be more inspiring than expected. She meets like-minded misfits who just want to ‘fuck shit up’ and live life to the fullest - snorting prescription drugs, downing vodka, skinny dipping... and maybe even falling in love.

Sunny Dancer is a coming-of-age comedy-romance celebrating love, friendship, and challenging adversity: feeling most alive whilst the world has other plans.
